newsitem.title: UK: LSE to launch screen-based covered warrants market.
newsitem.headline: LSE to launch screen-based covered warrants market.

text.p: The London Stock Exchange (LSE) is to launch a screen-based market for trading in covered warrants which is expected to go live in early June.

Under the exchange's proposal, covered warrants will be traded on SEATS PLUS, the Stock Exchange Alternative Trading System. This is the screen-based system currently used for the Alternative Investment Market (AIM) and less liquid securities.

"The warrants market in London has significant scope for expansion. By increasing investor awareness and providing a regulated electronic market, the Exchange is creating the climate for this growth to take place, particularly among knowledgeable individual investors," said the London Stock Exchange.
Market participants have until May 9 to return comments on the draft rules issued today.
